craft_notes: Sthāyin: blindfold casting. Rows: bring, kneel, cast. Read aloud: veiled step.

lines: Then the stumbling shunned, to see the coming spell made worthy,
bring the blindfold pupil in, make him kneel,
l4.sanskrit_cite: tato vikṣepaparihāreṇa bhāvimantradarśanayogyatāyai baddhanetraṃ śiṣyaṃ praveśya jānusthitaṃ taṃ kṛtvā puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣepayet
